name: Ribbon o Kiranaide
source:
Sometimes girls want to believe in the red string of fate, too.

My name is Saori Shinonome.
I'm 18 and a delicate, talented flower in a harsh world.
You try being this perky when you struggle like I do!

I got paired up with top idol Misakihime Shiratori!?
Together we are... Pinky Lady!

It wasn't going to be easy. But I'll do my very best ~ ^^

... so I told myself. But things aren't going well...

So much goes on behind the curtains in the world of show business.

Presenting a love adventure comedy. Curtains up!

By Manager Noriko 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE137386.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有时，女孩也想相信命运的红线。

我叫东云沙织。
我18岁，是残酷世界里纤细而有才华的花朵。
当你像我一样挣扎时，也试着保持活力啊！

我竟然和顶级偶像白鸟美咲姬组队了！？
我们一起是……Pinky Lady！

这不会轻松。但我会尽最大努力～^^

……我是这样告诉自己的。但事情进展得并不顺利……

演艺世界的幕后，有太多事情正在发生。

爱情冒险喜剧登场。帷幕升起！

——经纪人纪子

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE137386.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
